GenAiPlugin.description: Measure what changed after approved actions and feed outcome evidence back into the next recommendation.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Track actual outcomes, expected outcomes, metric definitions, time windows, evidence IDs, provider status, and next-plan changes.
Compare whether the issue improved, stayed open, got worse, or needs more evidence. Do not call a message delivery an outcome by itself.
Keep outcome wording simple: what changed, how measured, by when, and what Logia should learn for the next issue.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Use this topic after actions are approved or completed, or when the user asks what changed, what worked, or what to measure next.
